timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone of the dates. Default: Europe/Stockholm.

consented_values.title: Consented values
consented_values.description: Cell values meaning a consent was given, e.g. ["Ja"] (the default).

source.title: Source
source.description: Recorded as each row's source. Default: none.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Header names for the fixed columns, e.g. {"person_source_value": "Personnummer"}; ignore lists extra non-consent columns.
